symbols.name: scalar field
symbols.meaning: The field of scalars, the set of numbers that vectors are multiplied by.
symbols.quote: Let $F$ be a field, the set of scalars.

symbols.name: vector space
symbols.meaning: A vector space over $F$: a set of vectors with addition and multiplication by scalars from $F$.
symbols.quote: A vector space over $F$ is a set $V$ of vectors with an addition and with multiplication by scalars from $F$, obeying the usual rules.

symbols.name: scalar
symbols.meaning: An element of the scalar field $F$.
symbols.quote: For vectors $u,v$ in $V$ and a scalar $c$ in $F$, one such rule is $c(u+v)=cu+cv$.

symbols.name: linear map
symbols.meaning: A linear map from $V$ into itself, that is, a map with $L(u+v)=L(u)+L(v)$ and $L(cu)=cL(u)$.
symbols.quote: A linear map $L\colon V\to V$ is a map of $V$ into itself with $L(u+v)=L(u)+L(v)$ and $L(cu)=cL(u)$.
